hero.title: Jump to the exact moment a phrase is spoken
hero.subtitle: Paste any YouTube link, type a phrase, and JumpTo pinpoints every exact occurrence with one-click timestamps.

features.title: Why JumpTo
features.exactDesc: We search the full transcript word by word, so you only get timestamps where the exact phrase appears — no fuzzy matches.
features.fastDesc: Transcripts are cached, so once a video has been transcribed the results come back in milliseconds.
features.jumpDesc: Every result links straight to the exact moment, so you watch the scene instead of scrubbing.

steps.title: How it works
steps.step2Desc: A single word or a full sentence.
